name: Il Maresciallo Rocca e l'amico d'infanzia
original_name: Il Maresciallo Rocca e l'amico d'infanzia
overview: Rocca returns to Rome for Pietro's funeral—a man he had been close to since childhood. There, he reunites with Benedetto, his closest friend, and Elisa, his first love, whom he has never forgotten.
